name: newsletter-preview
title: Newsletter with preview
description: Subscribe with a look inside: the latest issue as a cover card beside the form, so people see exactly what they will receive.
docs: Pass onSubmit, the latest issue (number, title, date, three headlines and an href into your archive), a title and a description. The whole issue card is a link: one anchor inside it covers the card and carries the issue's title for a screen reader. date is a plain day or a time, written in locale and timeZone. promise (how often, how to leave) sits under the form and privacyHref adds the privacy line. readers is the count as you would say it aloud, '12,400', and appears as a sentence only when you pass it: pass it only when it is true and current. The address is checked in words when the form is sent, a failure keeps what was typed, and success replaces the form with a status message that takes focus. defaultValue and defaultStatus start it filled or confirmed. labels translates every fixed word.
